_start_comment: Start is the bare ship. The manifest (data/cargo.json) adds to it; the recommended manifest gives 22 adults, 8 children, 150 food/oxygen, 100 water, 80 alloy and a 6,000-mark debt.

deep._comment: The Deep: the level under the surface, reached by a Shaft.

drones._comment: Work drones, built at a Drone Bay. Drones work in this order while there are free Drone Bay slots.

grader.name: Grader
grader.desc: Clears and levels ground. Each working Grader adds a turn of progress to one surface building under construction.

borer.name: Borer
borer.desc: Bores through rock. Each working Borer adds a turn of progress to one Shaft or Deep building under construction. While you own one, digging into rock costs no extra alloy.

prospector.name: Prospector
prospector.desc: Roams the plains and brings back loose ore: 2 ore a turn.

hauler.name: Hauler
hauler.desc: Carries ore away from the cutters so they never stop: two working Seam Cutters make 25% more ore.

sweeper.name: Sweeper
sweeper.desc: Brushes grit off the Solar Arrays. In a grit storm, each working Sweeper keeps 4 arrays clean, so they lose much less power.

mechanic.name: Mechanic
mechanic.desc: Drives out to broken buildings. Each working Mechanic takes one more turn off one repair each turn.

medic.name: Medic
medic.desc: An ambulance rover. Each working Medic means 10% fewer deaths (up to 30%).

scout.name: Scout
scout.desc: Explores far from the colony. Each turn, each working Scout has a 15% chance of bringing back salvage: 8 alloy and 2 parts.

satellites._comment: Launched from a working Spin Launcher. Costs are alloy, parts and marks.

weather.name: Weather satellite
weather.desc: Warns of grit fronts and quakes: storms cut solar output half as much, and icequakes reach less far.

relay.name: Relay satellite
relay.desc: Keeps the colony in touch with home. Morale +3.

power.name: Power satellite
power.desc: A mirror in orbit that beams power down to a Beam Catcher.

survey.name: Survey satellite
survey.desc: Maps the ground from orbit and guides the work below: Seam Cutters and Ice Drills make 10% more.

waste._comment: Everyone makes waste. Some breaks down by itself; Reclaimers recycle the rest.

market._comment: Trading Post: goods it may sell, the base price in marks, and the reserve it always keeps. Prices swing up and down by 'swing' over 'period' turns.

probes._comment: Scouting probes sent before landing. 'free' come with every ship; each 'Survey probes' cargo bay adds 'per_cargo'. A site has a lucky find when its hash lands in the first few of 'find_slots' slots (one slot per find, so 3 finds in 6 slots is half the sites).

cache.name: Supply cache
cache.desc: An old supply drop lies by the site: 40 food and 40 oxygen to start with.
cache.log: The crew finds an old supply drop by the pad: 40 food and 40 oxygen.

seam.name: Rich ore seam
seam.desc: Ore breaks the surface right beside the site: two more seams next to the pad.
seam.log: Ore breaks the surface right beside the pad.

wreck.name: Crashed wreck
wreck.desc: A wrecked lander lies nearby: 25 alloy and 5 parts to salvage.
wreck.log: The crew salvages a wrecked lander near the pad: 25 alloy and 5 parts.
